BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

4. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

5. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

7. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

8. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.

9. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

10. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.

11. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

13. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

14. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.

15. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

16. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
